scope: Independent source/protocol/template review and tiny synthetic CPU/mocked release/process tests; no official arrays, actual CUDA, network, device inventory or process launches.

resolved_findings.finding: Earlier capacity failure path retained only history/context.
resolved_findings.resolution: Worker now saves unsuccessful model, Adam, gradients and RNG in a distinct non-promotable payload, or records the secondary preservation error while retaining all previous output.

resolved_findings.finding: Earlier paired verifier covered sample/noise/LR without all graph counterfactual invariants.
resolved_findings.resolution: Verifier now additionally requires exact native graph counts/hash, noisy state, exposure coin/material, annulus pairs and optional budget between paired arms.

reviewed: Inert default. Root-issued bounded capacity release binds exact source, interpreter, protocol and complete train/data/context/auxiliary/proof evidence. Source-only data contract carries no prospective scientific endpoint.

Complete reviewed numerical report is required: six case/arm combinations, two original/candidate updates each, graph gates, both serialized replays, 26 optimizer calls, nonzero optional exposure, and the fixed CUDA execution contract.

Fresh dedicated four-device host and fixed sequential 4+2 waves; raw GPU UUIDs match inherited nvidia-smi observations. PID/start/argv ownership, observed steady overlap, stopped/reaped outcomes, next-wave gating and bounded cleanup remain inherited from the pinned lifecycle.

512 updates with warmup64, paired deterministic host samples/noise, faithful objective, probe LR horizon100000 and unchanged v2 numerical routines. Scientific endpoint/promotion/resume interfaces are absent.

Capacity checkpoint schema, purpose and config remain distinct; saved model/Adam/RNG/history at0 and512 are audited on CPU for exact serialization, finite parameters/moments and Adam counts. Scientific restore rejects the payload.

Exact scalar/stdout/graph schedule rows, per-example particle counts and all paired initial/model/RNG/empty-Adam/native-graph/coin/noise invariants are checked. Optional expansions may differ according to the arm.
Worker failure state and secondary preservation errors are retained. Supervisor failures retain wave outcomes and prevent successful summary or automatic retry.
Worker config is bound to supervisor release/input hashes; terminal checks cover source/core/release, copied snapshots, observed wave records, both checkpoint digests and scalar artifacts.

q is measured wall time for updates65..512, r is nonnegative whole-process time minus all512 guarded updates. Per-wave maxima are engineering quantities only; no endpoint or full-study forecast is selected.
limits: Actual same-CUDA numerical success, dedicated host identity, six512 runs and checkpoint artifacts remain root-owned execution prerequisites; synthetic tests are not capacity evidence.
CPU checkpoint verification may overlap remaining workers and increase CPU contention/exit-observer lag. q/r describe the observed measurement process, not ideal uncontended training throughput.
Inherited lifecycle proves observed steady overlap, not continuous overlap at every point; raw launch skew, observer overhead and adverse outcomes must remain in evidence.
The timing release is not scientific training admission. All future final models require a fresh paired initialization and separately fixed endpoint/protocol.
